descriptions.w3d_d41d_worm_downward_contact_search_80: Starts a contact search along the worm's velocity, normalises the velocity, walks the found contacts, and for each contact's position takes the unit vector to the worm's raised position; returns 1 for the first surface facing up by more than 45 degrees that is hit while stationary or against the motion; ends the search and returns 0 otherwise.
